about: Surface terminations and adatoms. 'bond' per surface element where a value is known (the starting bond length; DFT relaxation decides the real one); for any other surface element CAPS uses the sum of covalent radii (Cordero 2008). 'range' is what the validator accepts for the surface–X distance.
